original_test_intent: Validate all sixteen F-suffix fan-speed channels across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence against the approved fan-control and cooling specification.
original_method: The cooling owner defines SPD and F, expands sixteen exact names, maps each channel to chassis position, fan module and rotor/tach input, defines its R-family pairing and state-qualified RPM criteria, and automation performs passive collection.
manual_activity: The cooling/platform owner defines SPD/F, maps sixteen positions to modules, rotors and tach channels, specifies F/R pairing and RPM behavior by PWM/power state, reviews all views and issues the verdict.
required_inputs: Authoritative SPD meaning and whether F denotes front rotor, forward fan, feed or another vendor channel
Exact SPD_FAN1_F through SPD_FAN16_F sensor names and fitted population
Per-index chassis zone/position, fan module serial/FRU, connector and rotor/tach input map
Pairing to SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R and allowed pair delta/ratio if applicable
RPM units, scaling, tolerance, refresh, zero/not-present/stale and fault semantics
Expected ranges by PWM command, cooling zone, system power, workload and ambient state
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target BMC/fan-controller/spec revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent cooling/power/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve sixteen exact names; neither endpoint range nor procedure shorthand is an exact query
Do not infer F meaning or substitute R-suffix evidence
Bind every speed channel to physical module, rotor/tach and cooling zone
Record PWM/power/workload/ambient state passively before applying ranges
Do not command fans, service modules, change cooling policy/thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/zero/stale RPM, F/R pairing mismatch, fan fault, thermal excursion or incomplete views
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, SPD/F definition, sixteen-name expansion and F/R pairing map
Verify fan population, module/rotor/tach topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, sixteen exact F results and BMC Web
Compare identity/RPM/state/freshness with passive PWM, paired-R, fan health, temperature and SEL context
Perform no R substitution, fan control/service, workload, cooling/BMC mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define SPD/F and approve sixteen module/rotor/tach positions
Approve F/R pairing and pair-balance criteria
Provide PWM/power/ambient-qualified RPM ranges and fault semantics
Review all sixteen F channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the owner-approved list of sixteen exact F-suffix names, then collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web and passive PWM/pair/thermal context.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SIXTEEN-CHANNEL FAN/ROTOR MAP, F/R PAIR CONTRACT AND STATE-QUALIFIED RPM LIMITS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a 16-row map from exact F sensor to chassis position, module/rotor/tach, paired R channel, cooling zone and approved RPM envelope, then reconcile complete management views at one recorded control state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates ambiguous range/shorthand strings and makes dual-rotor pairing and controller state explicit before RPM comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The next R-suffix case remains an independent set of sixteen channels; its readings may support pair analysis but cannot satisfy F-channel coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fan RPM is controlled by PWM, thermal policy and power state, so static limits or unproven F/R semantics can falsely flag normal modulation or miss a failed rotor in a dual-rotor module.

project_override_considerations: Unfitted fan positions require owner-approved not-present behavior. If F/R are not paired rotors, remove pair arithmetic and use the authoritative vendor channel relationship instead.
expected_evidence: Approved SPD/F definition and exact sixteen-name/fitted-population list
Sixteen chassis/module/rotor/tach/zone identities plus R-family relationship
RPM scale, freshness, fault and PWM/power/workload/ambient-qualified criteria
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus sixteen exact F results
BMC Web, same-target proof and passive PWM/paired-R/fan-health/temperature/SEL context
No-fan-control/no-module-service/no-cooling/no-threshold/no-reset/no-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure use two shorthand forms for the same F-suffix family; neither is accepted as an exact sensor name. The intended sixteen-channel scope remains identifiable with owner-approved expansion.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive sixteen-channel speed review is identifiable after the owner supplies SPD/F semantics, physical pairing and criteria under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds exact expansion, module/rotor/tach identity, F/R pairing and controller-state-qualified RPM logic while preventing shorthand strings from being treated as executable names.
independent_technical_reasoning: In dual-rotor fan modules, front and rear tach channels can have different nominal speeds and failure signatures even under one PWM command. Without proving what F means and how each tach maps to a physical rotor, a healthy partner can mask a failed rotor or an invalid static range can misclassify normal control behavior.
